hypothesis.title: Change Order.discount_within_total validator from classmethod to instance method
hypothesis.rationale: The error indicates that using `@model_validator(mode='after')` on a classmethod is deprecated in Pydantic 2.12. The validator in the Order class is defined with first parameter `cls`, making it a classmethod. Changing it to an instance method (first parameter `self`) and accessing attributes via `self` will resolve the deprecation warning.
hypothesis.strategy: Replace the classmethod validator with an instance method validator by changing the first parameter from `cls` to `self` and updating the body to use `self.lines` and `self.discount_cents`.
